Surtling trophy

Type: Trophy | Internal ID: TrophySurtling | Source: Surtling | Usage: Decoration | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

Introduction. The Surtling trophy is a rare drop from Surtlings found within the Swamp.
